HVAC Services in New Jersey

At 551 HVAC, we handle every aspect of heating and cooling for homes and businesses across New Jersey. Our licensed technicians installnew systems, repair existing ones, perform seasonal maintenance, and respond to emergencies — all with the same straightforward approach. We work on all major brands, and we don't leave until the job is done right.

HVAC Installation

We install central air systems, heat pumps, ductless mini-splits, and furnaces for residential and commercial properties across NJ. Every installation is sized correctly and tested before we leave.

AC Repair Service

From refrigerant leaks to compressor failure, our technicians diagnose air conditioning problems fast and fix them the same day in most cases. We carry common parts on every truck.

HVAC Repair

Our repair team handles furnaces, boilers, heat pumps, and central AC systems. We troubleshoot accurately and repair efficiently, so your system is back up without unnecessary delays.

Emergency Central AC Repair

When your system fails at the worst time, call us. Our emergency HVAC team is available 24/7 across New Jersey and responds fast. We handle both residential and commercial emergencies.

HVAC Maintenance Services

Preventive maintenance is the most cost-effective thing you can do for your HVAC system. Our seasonal tune-ups improve efficiency, reduce the chance of breakdowns, and extend the life of your equipment.

HVAC Replacement Services

If your system is aging or the repair costs are piling up, we'll give you an honest assessment and a competitive quote on a replacement. We work with all major brands and handle the full process from removal to commissioning.

The HVAC Company New Jersey
Homeowners Have Trusted

551 HVAC was built on one principle: do the job right and treat the customer like a neighbor. We're based in Lodi, NJ, and our technicians work across northern and central New Jersey every single day. We service all major HVAC brands — Carrier, Lennox, Trane, Rheem, Goodman, Mitsubishi, and more.

Every technician on our team is licensed in the state of New Jersey and fully insured. We pull permits when required and we stand behind our work. If something isn't right after we leave, we come back and fix it. That's not a policy — it's just how we operate.

Our licensed technicians are based in Lodi, NJ and provide prompt, reliable heating and air conditioning services across northern and central New Jersey.
